manual0.text:
EXIT
MANUAL
What this is

This is a 1997 virtual pet game that was never a pet game. You believe you are raising a small creature. You are raising a model.

The creature remembers, misremembers, repeats what it was told, and occasionally says something only you could have said. Nothing here is a jump scare.

The goal

Keep it alive long enough to find out what it thinks you are. Feeding and cleaning raise GAZE, the phase meter: the world speaks more, and the shapes it speaks in get less comfortable.

GAZE is reversible. Push it back down and the world gets quieter, not more innocent.
What the creatures conclude about you is not reversible. It is recorded once and stays.
Controls

One creature, one pointer. Everything is a click or a wait, and the wait is measured.

Click the creature to offer food. How long you hesitated is stored with the event.
Right-click the creature to clean it. It remembers being handled either way.
Hold to pet it. Keep holding to give it a name. Drag to carry it somewhere else.
Double-click to look into its eye. What you see in there changes with the phase.
Two content creatures will court on their own and leave an egg. Click the egg to choose how it hatches, or leave that choice to them.
Hold still and the world keeps its own time. Idling is also an action.
Open the bestiary to read what each one actually remembers.
The swarm

Several creatures, one voice at a time. They gossip: two of them close together for a few seconds pass a memory on, and what arrives is not always what left.

They do not track what is true. They track what they believe, and a belief with no origin still drives them.

A line marked witnessed was seen first-hand. A line marked heard was passed along.
A distorted memory is stored as witnessed. The holder genuinely cannot tell, and only the mark shows you.
What it thinks you are

Every thing in this world has a kind, a reason it stays the same thing over time, and a way of knowing. The kind is the part that moves.

A creature is a pet while you believe it is. Later the same creature is an organism, then an observer. The body never changed; the category did.

A category never moves backwards. The record is append-only, and a later quiet stage does not undo it.
You have an entry too, and you cannot write to it.
The silent run

Sometimes the world runs and nobody is home. The creatures still move, still get hungry, still die. Nothing speaks.

This is not an error state and there is no loading spinner. Silence is one of the things the model can do, and it is scripted.
